name: write_sd600
outputs: --full-out (inside a folder named tmp): sd600.json or sd600.edit.json (text); --out: the text-free records
prompts_rule: the prompts command writes A1's 600 rows' stored prompts, in A1's selection order, as the stage-1 prompt list sd600 (REQ-9's input)
requirement: REQ-15 (brief rev 1; PLAN-S:165; PLANF:116); lead decisions L14 (3); REV3's DIFFUSE branch (SD-600 at the front of family 1c)
rule: L14 (3): rewrite an A1 row with the untuned greedy answer only if the answer ended, answer.strip() is non-empty and encode_train(prompt, answer, S.max_train_tokens) accepts it; every other row of A1's 600 is removed (a combined edit: remove k, rewrite 600 - k); never truncated; k is reported by reason (capped, empty, too_long, control_token), with the category mix, the A1 ranks and the token mass; no stop rule on k; before writing, the edit is parsed with the engine's parse_edit and every rewritten row encoded with the engine's edited_corpus against its audited encoding
